purpose: Smallest paper-facing contract set that can describe a scientifically meaningful audio-tactile PPS task. It is an evidence inventory, not an automatic emulation-readiness certificate; exact current serializer paths remain a separate implementation crosswalk.
canonicalization_rules: Store one body-relative 3D position representation and derive duplicate polar or Cartesian coordinates.
For moving stimuli require geometry plus duration, or geometry plus path length and speed; derive the redundant kinematic quantity and preserve its formula.
Normalize SOAs to a declared auditory-onset anchor/sign convention; distance-at-touch anchors count only when trajectory kinematics can derive SOAs.
Use one trial-allocation rule per family and derive include flags, percentages and totals.
Keep paper evidence, derived values, low-confidence candidates, Toolkit defaults and template encodings distinguishable.
Keep trial-generation baselines separate from EEG or analysis baseline windows.

Keep measurement acquisition and primary-outcome definitions separate from offline analysis/model fitting; behavioral-only studies may reference the task-response contract through a native response-log binding.

auditory_source_mode.generated: Procedural/noise-generator or synthesized source with a reproducible recipe.
auditory_source_mode.imported_asset: Recorded or authored audio file whose identity or approved substitute must be resolved.
auditory_source_mode.physical_source: A real-world sound source or apparatus produces the sound directly.
auditory_source_mode.hybrid: The executable stimulus combines generated, imported, or physical-source elements.
auditory_source_mode.unclear: The reviewed source does not distinguish the source implementation.

trajectory_motion_mode.static: One or more fixed source positions; no continuous auditory motion is synthesized.
trajectory_motion_mode.approach: The auditory source moves toward the declared body anchor.
trajectory_motion_mode.recede: The auditory source moves away from the declared body anchor.
trajectory_motion_mode.bidirectional: Approaching and receding trajectories are both experimental conditions.
trajectory_motion_mode.discrete_switching: Apparent motion is implemented by ordered physical or virtual source switches.
trajectory_motion_mode.gain_only_proxy: Looming/receding is represented by a level envelope without metric 3D motion.
trajectory_motion_mode.custom: A nonstandard or nonlinear trajectory requires an explicit ordered path.

timing_policy_type.none: The reviewed procedure explicitly uses no jitter or variable interval.
timing_policy_type.fixed: One fixed interval value is used.
timing_policy_type.discrete_set: Intervals are selected from a finite reported set.
timing_policy_type.uniform_range: Intervals are sampled from a reported continuous or stepped uniform range.
timing_policy_type.nonuniform_distribution: A named or otherwise specified nonuniform distribution is used.
timing_policy_type.pseudorandom_sequence: A constrained or predetermined pseudorandom timing sequence is used.
timing_policy_type.manual_or_event_driven: The next trial is started manually or by an external event.
timing_policy_type.custom: A study-specific timing policy requires its own rule.
timing_policy_type.not_reported: The reviewed source does not provide the timing policy.

baseline_family.none: The trial inventory explicitly contains no separate baseline/control trial family.
baseline_family.tactile_only_unspecified: Unimodal tactile trials are present but their timing relation is not fully classified.
baseline_family.tactile_only_endpoint_pre_post: Tactile-only trials occur before sound onset, after sound offset, or at trajectory endpoints.
baseline_family.tactile_only_soa_matched: Tactile-only trials match every or selected audio-tactile SOA anchors.
baseline_family.static_or_fixed_distance_expectancy_cont: A fixed/static auditory position or timing controls expectancy against the moving condition.
baseline_family.unisensory_factorial_control: Tactile-only and/or auditory-only rows are factorial multisensory controls rather than a single RT baseline ladder.
baseline_family.no_stimulation_control: No-stimulation rows or blocks provide the trial-generation control.
baseline_family.custom_mixed_control: Multiple distinct trial-control families must be represented separately.
baseline_family.analysis_only_excluded: An EEG/MEP/prestimulus analysis window is reported but is not a generated baseline trial family.

catch_family.none: The reviewed trial inventory explicitly contains no catch/no-target family.
catch_family.auditory_only_withhold: Sound is presented without the tactile target and the participant withholds a response.
catch_family.no_stimulation_withhold: No target stimulus is presented and the participant withholds a response.
catch_family.tactile_nontarget_withhold: A strong, weak, wrong-site, or otherwise designated tactile nontarget requires withholding.
catch_family.combined_no_target_families: More than one no-target/catch family is used and must be allocated separately.
catch_family.rare_target_monitoring: Most trials are target-absent while rare probes define the response task.
catch_family.auditory_only_response_target_not_catch: Auditory-only trials require a response and must remain a target/control family, not be collapsed into catch trials.
catch_family.unisensory_control_not_catch: Auditory-only or other unisensory rows are analysis controls and not behavioral catches.

allocation_mode.exact_count: An exact row/trial count is reported.
allocation_mode.repetition_factor: A repetition count is applied over an explicitly named factorial cell set.
allocation_mode.percentage_with_denominator: A percentage is reported together with a denominator or crossing rule sufficient to resolve an exact count.
allocation_mode.reported_formula: A reported arithmetic rule resolves the allocation.
allocation_mode.derived_formula: The allocation is derived from reported factors and the formula is preserved.
allocation_mode.unresolved_percentage: A percentage is reported without enough denominator/crossing information to resolve the count.
allocation_mode.not_reported: No defensible allocation rule was recovered.

study_design_family.single_measurement: One PPS measurement occasion is scheduled for each participant or cohort.
study_design_family.repeated_measure: PPS is measured more than once without requiring a parallel-group or crossover topology.
study_design_family.parallel_group: Participants are assigned to distinct between-participant arms or cohorts.
study_design_family.crossover: Participants receive multiple interventions or conditions in a declared within-participant sequence.
study_design_family.mixed_factorial: The study combines between-participant and within-participant factors.
study_design_family.adaptive: Later study activities or assignments depend on earlier observations.
study_design_family.custom: A study-specific topology requires an explicit schedule beyond the standard families.
study_design_family.unclear: The reviewed source does not resolve the study-design family.

study_assignment_scope.single_cohort: All participants follow one declared cohort schedule.
study_assignment_scope.between_participant_arms: Participants are assigned to distinct arms that receive different schedules or conditions.
study_assignment_scope.within_participant: The same participants receive all declared conditions or occasions.
study_assignment_scope.mixed_between_within: Both between-participant assignment and within-participant repetition are present.
study_assignment_scope.observational_cohorts: Pre-existing cohorts are compared without experimental assignment.
study_assignment_scope.custom: A study-specific assignment topology is declared explicitly.

pps_occurrence_pattern.single_pps: One PPS measurement occurs per participant schedule.
pps_occurrence_pattern.repeated_pre_post: PPS is measured before and after an intervention or manipulation.
pps_occurrence_pattern.repeated_multi_timepoint: PPS is measured at three or more declared timepoints.
pps_occurrence_pattern.condition_specific_pps_sessions: Separate PPS sessions or visits are bound to different conditions.
pps_occurrence_pattern.within_session_block_conditions: Conditions are manipulated between PPS blocks in one session.
pps_occurrence_pattern.within_session_trial_conditions: Conditions vary between trials within a PPS measurement.
pps_occurrence_pattern.multi_scope: The design combines more than one PPS occurrence pattern.
pps_occurrence_pattern.custom: A study-specific PPS occurrence pattern is declared explicitly.
pps_occurrence_pattern.unclear: The PPS occurrence pattern remains unresolved.

study_factor_scope.between_participant: A factor level is assigned between participants or cohorts.
study_factor_scope.between_visit: A factor varies between visits for the same participant.
study_factor_scope.between_session: A factor varies between sessions within a visit or study schedule.
study_factor_scope.between_measurement: A factor varies between distinct PPS measurement occasions.
study_factor_scope.between_block: A factor varies between blocks within one PPS measurement.
study_factor_scope.within_block_trial: A factor varies trial-by-trial within a block.
study_factor_scope.continuous_during_measurement: A factor changes continuously during a PPS measurement.
study_factor_scope.event_locked: A factor level is tied to a specific scheduled event.
study_factor_scope.custom: A study-specific factor scope is declared explicitly.

study_factor_role.experimental_manipulation: A manipulated experimental condition whose levels are scheduled or assigned.
study_factor_role.timepoint: A repeated measurement occasion or temporal sampling factor.
study_factor_role.intervention_arm: A treatment, training, or comparison arm assigned between participants or sequences.
study_factor_role.participant_attribute: A measured participant attribute or pre-existing cohort characteristic.
study_factor_role.protocol_variant: A variant of the PPS protocol/profile rather than an external intervention.
study_factor_role.counterbalance: A sequence/order group used to counterbalance conditions.
study_factor_role.context_state: A participant or environmental state varied or observed around PPS measurement.
study_factor_role.control_task: A control or secondary task factor.
study_factor_role.nuisance: A tracked nuisance or adjustment factor needed for faithful scheduling or analysis.

study_assignment_method.all_participants: Every participant receives all declared levels or follows the same schedule.
study_assignment_method.observed_cohort: Levels identify observed or pre-existing cohorts rather than randomized assignment.
study_assignment_method.random_parallel: Participants are randomized to parallel between-participant arms.
study_assignment_method.stratified_random: Random assignment is stratified or blocked by declared participant attributes.
study_assignment_method.counterbalanced_sequence: Within-participant condition order is counterbalanced across declared sequences.
study_assignment_method.latin_square: Order is allocated using a Latin-square schedule.
study_assignment_method.crossover_random_order: Participants receive crossover conditions in randomized order.
study_assignment_method.fixed_order: All participants or a declared group follow a fixed order.
study_assignment_method.custom: A study-specific assignment/order algorithm is declared explicitly.
study_assignment_method.unclear: Assignment or order method remains unresolved.

study_schedule_event_kind.pps_measurement: A PPS measurement using a bound Toolkit protocol/profile.
study_schedule_event_kind.intervention: A treatment or experimental intervention outside the PPS protocol itself.
study_schedule_event_kind.training: A training procedure intended to alter later performance or state.
study_schedule_event_kind.manipulation: A scheduled manipulation that is not itself the PPS measurement.
study_schedule_event_kind.washout: A washout interval between conditions or interventions.
study_schedule_event_kind.secondary_task: A scheduled non-PPS measurement or task.
study_schedule_event_kind.instruction: A scheduled instruction or briefing event.
study_schedule_event_kind.custom: A study-specific event kind is declared explicitly.

study_schedule_execution_mode.toolkit_protocol: The activity is executed by a typed PPS Toolkit protocol/profile.
study_schedule_execution_mode.toolkit_instruction_timer: The Toolkit can represent the activity only as instructions and/or a timer.
study_schedule_execution_mode.external_operator: An operator performs or controls the activity outside the PPS protocol.
study_schedule_execution_mode.external_device: An external device or software system executes the activity.
study_schedule_execution_mode.metadata_only: The activity is retained for scheduling/provenance but is not executable by the Toolkit.
study_schedule_execution_mode.custom: A study-specific execution adapter is declared explicitly.

study_schedule_relation.sequence_start: The event starts the declared participant schedule or branch.
study_schedule_relation.before: The event occurs before its referenced event.
study_schedule_relation.after: The event occurs after its referenced event.
study_schedule_relation.between: The event occurs between referenced schedule anchors.
study_schedule_relation.during: The event occurs during its referenced event.
study_schedule_relation.concurrent: The event is concurrent with its referenced event.
study_schedule_relation.same_session: The event shares a session with its referenced event without a more exact order claim.
study_schedule_relation.separate_session: The event occurs in a separate session from its referenced event.
study_schedule_relation.separate_visit: The event occurs in a separate visit from its referenced event.
study_schedule_relation.custom: A study-specific temporal relation is declared explicitly.

measurement_outcome_family.behavioral_response: The primary measurement is a behavioral response such as reaction time, accuracy, detection, or localization.
measurement_outcome_family.eeg_erp: Scalp EEG or an event-related EEG potential is the primary measurement.
measurement_outcome_family.intracranial_eeg: Intracranial EEG/ECoG/depth-electrode activity is the primary measurement.
measurement_outcome_family.tms_mep: TMS-evoked motor potentials or related corticospinal excitability measures are primary.
measurement_outcome_family.ecg_cardiac: ECG or another cardiac measure is primary.
measurement_outcome_family.other_physiology: A physiological signal outside the named families is primary.
measurement_outcome_family.multimodal: More than one acquisition family jointly defines the study outcome.
measurement_outcome_family.custom: A study-specific outcome family is declared explicitly.
measurement_outcome_family.unclear: The primary measurement family remains unresolved.

measurement_binding_mode.native_response_log: The Toolkit's native response/event log is the acquisition authority; response mechanics stay in the task-response contract.
measurement_binding_mode.lsl_external_stream: An external acquisition stream is synchronized through LSL markers or clocks.
measurement_binding_mode.labrecorder_xdf: A LabRecorder XDF capture binds Toolkit markers to external streams.
measurement_binding_mode.hardware_triggered_external_system: A hardware trigger binds the Toolkit schedule to an external acquisition system.
measurement_binding_mode.external_file_import: Acquisition occurs externally and is joined later through declared IDs/timestamps.
measurement_binding_mode.operator_recorded: An operator records the primary outcome outside a direct software/device binding.
measurement_binding_mode.custom: A study-specific acquisition adapter is declared explicitly.

measurement_clock_sync_method.native_audio_sample_clock: Native response/events are anchored to the Toolkit audio/sample timing authority.
measurement_clock_sync_method.toolkit_lsl_markers: Toolkit LSL markers provide the synchronization contract.
measurement_clock_sync_method.hardware_trigger: A physical trigger/TTL channel provides synchronization.
measurement_clock_sync_method.shared_device_clock: Stimulus and acquisition share one device clock.
measurement_clock_sync_method.synchronized_clocks: Separate systems use an explicit clock-synchronization method.
measurement_clock_sync_method.posthoc_alignment: Signals are aligned after acquisition using declared events or timestamps.
measurement_clock_sync_method.none: No cross-system synchronization is required for the declared native measurement.
measurement_clock_sync_method.custom: A study-specific synchronization method is declared explicitly.

contracts.label: Auditory stimulus
contracts.description: Generated, imported, or physical sound identity plus an executable recipe, asset, or declared substitute; method-defining level/envelope/calibration and renderer details remain conditional. A missing private WAV requires an explicit approximation decision.

contracts.label: Trajectory and kinematics
contracts.description: Static or moving body-relative geometry plus a reconstructible timing constraint. Moving paths require duration, or path length plus speed; static sources require positions and active duration. Path length, direction and redundant speed/duration are derived.

contracts.label: Trial sequence
contracts.description: Every trial family and its ordered auditory, tactile, wait, and source-selection elements, with method-defining within-trial timing and condition intermixing.

contracts.label: Task and response
contracts.description: Target/no-target rule, response or explicit passive/no-response mode, device/mapping, and any method-defining response-window anchor or scoring policy. The current design serializer has no first-class response contract.
runtime_or_untyped_inputs: session_runner response policy; fixed global defaults remain an implementation gap

contracts.label: Jitter and ITI policy
contracts.description: Explicit none, fixed, discrete, range, or custom timing policy and whether it is a foreperiod, within-sequence gap, post-sound delay, or true intertrial interval. Audio padding is not silently treated as ITI.

contracts.label: SOA schedule
contracts.description: Ordered audio-tactile onset schedule with a declared reference/sign convention, or distance-at-touch anchors only when trajectory kinematics can derive the SOAs.

contracts.label: Tactile target
contracts.description: Tactile modality, body site/side, cue waveform/duration, and method-defining intensity/calibration or trigger mechanics needed to synthesize or route an equivalent cue.

contracts.label: Baseline/control trials
contracts.description: Explicit absence or a trial-generation control family (for example tactile-only, static/far, SOA-matched, endpoint, sound-offset, or custom), with timing anchor and an exact count or reconstructible allocation. EEG/analysis baselines are excluded.

contracts.label: Catch/no-target trials
contracts.description: Explicit absence or a catch/no-target family, its expected response/withhold rule, and an exact count or reconstructible percentage with denominator/crossing rule. Auditory-only target/control rows remain distinct from catches.

contracts.label: Repetition allocation
contracts.description: Repetition count or exact allocation rule and the SOA, condition and family dimensions it applies over; total trials are a derived validation, not a substitute.

contracts.label: Block and order policy
contracts.description: Block count and composition, plus method-defining pool repeat/distribution, randomization, counterbalancing and sequence constraints. A single block is an explicit complete case.

contracts.label: Study structure and schedule
contracts.description: Participant sample/arm assignment, study topology, repeated PPS occasions, factor scopes, protocol bindings, and any intervention/order/spacing schedule needed to reproduce who receives which PPS measurement and when. This belongs in a future pre-run pps-study-plan.v1 artifact; it is not a Segment 6 participant-order count and is not currently typed by the design serializer.
runtime_or_untyped_inputs: legacy metadata is provenance-only and must not be treated as a typed study-plan adapter
prepared runner packages currently encode at most one fixed one/two-part participant schedule

contracts.label: Measurement acquisition and outcome
contracts.description: The recorded dependent measure and its acquisition binding: outcome family/measure, native response-log or external device/channels, event/clock synchronization, acquisition epoch or response-window reference, and primary outcome definition. Behavioral-only studies may bind to the native response log and reference the task-response contract instead of duplicating response mechanics. Analysis models and offline inferential pipelines are excluded.
compiler_derived_outputs: optional LabRecorder XDF capture and capture report
runtime_or_untyped_inputs: no typed EEG/iEEG/TMS/ECG device, channel, epoch, or primary-outcome adapter
